Give two of the Five Pillars of Islam.
(2)

content.question_html:
Explain two ways in which a belief in the resurrection of Jesus influences Christians today.
(4)
content.mark_scheme_html:
Two marks for each way that is explained, for example:

It gives hope of life after death, so Christians may face death with less fear
(2)
It shows the power of God over evil, which gives Christians confidence to live as Jesus taught
(2)

content.question_html:
Explain two Muslim beliefs about angels. Refer to sacred writings or another source of Muslim belief and teaching in your answer.
(5)
content.mark_scheme_html:
Two marks for each belief that is explained, plus one mark for a relevant reference to a source of authority.

  • Angels are created from light and always obey God
  • Jibril revealed the Qur'an to Muhammad
  • Angels record every person's deeds for the Day of Judgement
  • Reference to the Qur'an or Hadith

content.question_html:
'The best way for Christians to grow closer to God is by going on pilgrimage.' Evaluate this statement. In your answer you should give reasoned arguments for and against the statement, refer to Christian teaching, and reach a justified conclusion.
(12)
content.mark_scheme_html:
Marked by level of response. Top-level answers are detailed, well organised and reach a supported judgement.

Indicative content:

  • For: time away from daily life to pray; places such as Lourdes and Iona; walking where Jesus walked
  • Against: prayer, worship and the Eucharist are available every day; serving others is commanded by Jesus
  • Not all Christian traditions value pilgrimage equally
  • A justified conclusion

content.question_html:
'Religious believers should never agree with euthanasia.' Evaluate this statement. In your answer you should give reasoned arguments for and against the statement, refer to religious arguments, and reach a justified conclusion.
(12)
content.mark_scheme_html:
Marked by level of response. Top-level answers are detailed, well organised and reach a supported judgement.

Indicative content:

  • For: the sanctity of life; life is a gift from God; 'Do not murder'
  • Against: compassion and quality of life; some believers accept withdrawing treatment
  • Non-religious arguments about autonomy may be used
  • A justified conclusion

content.question_html:
'War is never justified.' Evaluate this statement. In your answer you should give reasoned arguments for and against the statement, refer to religious arguments, and reach a justified conclusion.
(12)
content.mark_scheme_html:
Marked by level of response. Top-level answers are detailed, well organised and reach a supported judgement.

Indicative content:

  • For: pacifism; 'Blessed are the peacemakers'; the suffering of civilians
  • Against: just war theory; self-defence and the protection of the innocent; lesser jihad
  • Modern weapons and whether the conditions for a just war can be met
  • A justified conclusion
